breakdown.description: The traction-free hole boundary is replaced by an artificial radial displacement constraint
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and elaborates on the incorrect constraint from the incomplete prompt. It instructs to impose zero normal displacement on the hole boundary via a penalty method (adding alpha * dot(u,n) * dot(v,n) * ds(3) to the bilinear form), directly contradicting the ground truth which requires the hole boundary to be left traction-free (a natural boundary condition with no displacement constraints imposed).
